subject: Invoice 2026/481 - design software licence
body: Hello, please find attached our invoice no. 2026/481 for the annual licence. Total due: €1,476.00, payable within 30 days. Best regards, TechSoft Ltd

subject: Order arrived damaged - third time this month
body: This is unacceptable. The boxes arrived crushed again and half the products are unusable. If this is not solved this week we will cancel our contract.

subject: Quote for 200 units?
body: Hi, could you send us a quote for 200 units of the standard model, with delivery to Braga before the end of November? Thanks, Marta

subject: Reminder: payment overdue
body: Dear customer, our invoice 1187 of €340.50 issued on 2 September is now 25 days overdue. Please arrange payment as soon as possible.

subject: Team lunch on Friday
body: Hi all, we're booking a table at 13:00 on Friday to celebrate the new office. Let me know if you're coming!

subject: Can we change the delivery address?
body: Hello, we moved warehouses. Could future deliveries go to Rua das Flores 12, Porto instead? Our order from yesterday hasn't shipped yet.
